meta.title: Ralph loops
meta.description: Ask for a Ralph loop with a goal that can be checked from the files, and the agent starts a fresh agent on it round after round until a round reports the goal met or a blocker, or the round limit is reached. Each round sees only the goal, the files, and the last round's report, and is a full agent run, so cost grows with each round. Completion and blockers are the last agent's own report; check the result yourself.
